programme.desc: 'S1/E7 - 18 Cooks Survive'. Fifteen cooks compete, starting with a team challenge. Then, the competitors face off in a taco night throwdown and a best cheesy dish challenge.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S49/E5 - Comfort Food Feud: Finale'. Four champions battle for the $25,000 prize. In each round, the ingredient baskets contain delicious reminders of the tournament's culinary themes.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: 'S24/E6 - Wheres The Meat'. Ree Drummond makes a meat-free Tex Mex frittata and shares other meat-free meals. They include mixed mushroom cheesesteak sandwiches and Cajun veggies.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: 'S24/E7 - Chucks Dinner'. Ree makes dinner for her father-in-law, Chuck. The menu includes all his favourites, from Chuck's enchiladas to quick roasted salsa to apple crisp for dessert.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: 'S24/E8 - Oh Boy'. Ree cooks for her always-hungry teenage sons. She makes buffalo chicken totchos, a fun twist on pizza with her broccoli cheese Stromboli and a one-pot beef noodle skillet.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: 'S24/E9 - Speedy Seafood 4 Ways'. Ree prepares speedy seafood done four ways. She makes coconut shrimp and mango dipping sauce Greek grilled salmon with veggies, and a mixed seafood pasta.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: 'S24/E10 - Quarterback Mom'. Ree's quarterback teens have a big game coming up so she makes their favourite food, including meatball subs, spicy mac and cheese, and confetti blondies.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: 'S24/E11 - Birthday for Two'. It's Ree and Ladd's birthdays so they celebrate with skillet spaghetti with meatballs and garlic bread. Then, they enjoy a black forest cake for dessert.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: 'S24/E12 - Ask Me Anything Wildcard'. Ree Drummond answers questions from friends, townsfolk and visitors to Pawhuska. She shares her ribeye banh mi Vietnamese sandwich plus other tasty recipes.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: 'S24/E13 - Fire And Feast'. Ree Drummond cooks a spring feast while Ladd and the cowboys are busy on the ranch. She makes pork tenderloin with herby mustard cream and mac and cheese primavera.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: 'S25/E1 - All Grown Up'. Ree Drummond packs a kitchen-equipment care package for her daughter Alex. There's a delicious quarter sheet pan supper and a wonton taco cup dish.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: 'S25/E2 - 16 Minute Meals Italian'. Ree Drummond makes a trio of marvellous 16-minute Italian meals. She serves up a speedy pork scaloppini dinner plus steak pizzaiola.

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S27/E9 - Skillets, Bakes And Casseroles'. The hosts are sharing their favourite regional recipes and fresh side options. Dishes include New York-inspired cheesy spinach manicotti with lemon.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S49/E6 - Hangry Baskets: Late Night'. The chefs get baskets inspired by late-night cravings. In round one, the chefs must create a dish using frozen pizza, meatballs and maitake mushrooms.

programme.title: The Ultimate Baking Championship
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - The Pastry Shop'. The eight remaining chefs work in teams to craft exquisite, laminated dough pastries worthy of display in a world-class patisserie case.

programme.title: The Ultimate Baking Championship
programme.desc: 'S1/E5 - Innovation'. The seven remaining chefs must create an elevated plated dessert inspired by a gas station snack. Then, the chefs reinterpret classic desserts.

programme.title: The Ultimate Baking Championship
programme.desc: 'S1/E6 - Mastery Of Chocolate'. The chefs create a visually stunning chocolate sculptural piece along with a complementary baked element inspired by their chocolate creation.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S4/E9 - Pittsburgh'. Andrew explores the favourite foods of Pittsburgh - home to a half-pound fish sandwich, as well as hearty recipes like kielbasa, stuffed cabbage and pierogi.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S4/E10 - Veracruz'. Andrew explores the food of Veracruz, Mexico, by sampling Arroz a la tumbada, which includes a whole boiled octopus, as well as favourites like chile relleno and picaditas.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S4/E11 - Managua'. Andrew reveals the must-try foods of Nicaragua's capital Managua. He tries a steamed beef dish called baho to the crispy pork skin-topped salad known as vigaron.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple...
programme.desc: 'Diners, Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple D Nation. S6/E2 - Triple D Nation: Diner Dishes'. Guy Fieri digs in diner style with mighty mac 'n cheese in Atlanta, brisket hash in San Antonio and a supreme breakfast burrito in Scottsdale, AZ.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple...
programme.desc: 'Diners, Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple D Nation. S6/E3 - Triple D Nation: Africa & Asia'. Guy Fieri heads back for a taste of Thailand in Boulder, CO, Pakistani favourites in Tempe, AZ, and Moroccan specialties in San Antonio.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple...
programme.desc: 'Diners, Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple D Nation. S6/E4 - Triple D Nation: Dough'ed Up'. Guy Fieri digs into dynamite doughs with focaccia burgers in Colorado, decadent dulce de leche cookies in San Antonio and a Sicilian pie in Arizona.

programme.title: Kids Baking Championship
programme.desc: 'S12/E4 - Art Is In The Pie Of The Beholder'. Valerie Bertinelli and Duff Goldman ask the bakers to make colourful mosaic pies filled with cubes of gelatine suspended in creamy pie filling.

programme.title: The Ultimate Baking Championship
programme.desc: 'S1/E8 - The Deep Freeze'. The remaining four chefs create arctic-themed cakes with a frozen layer. The bottom two chefs battle in a sudden-death round for a spot in the finale.

programme.title: La Pitchoune: Cooking In France
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - All Things Provence'. Makenna highlights Provence and welcomes students with vastly different skill levels - from a total kitchen novice to a cookbook author.

programme.title: Street Food In Africa
programme.desc: 'S1/E5'. There is a rich culture and history of street food in Africa. Chef Nti explores the delicious dishes on offer and recreates some of her favourite recipes.

programme.title: Ready Jet Cook
programme.desc: 'S1/E5 - Soups'. Jet Tila cooks up two noodle soups that are near and dear to his heart, a quick beef pho and Japanese spicy miso ramen.

programme.title: Ready Jet Cook
programme.desc: 'S1/E6 - Shrimp'. Jet Tila makes shrimp the star when he stir-fries up a flavour-packed kung pao shrimp and his salt and pepper shrimp with veggie-loaded fried rice.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games

programme.desc: 'S43/E3 - Hot Dogs, Hot Knots, And Ramen'. Guy Fieri tastes high-octane hot dogs near Asheville, primo Sicilian pie in Reno, and delicious noodle bowls in Calgary, Alberta.

programme.desc: 'S14/E6 - How The West Covina Was Won'. Lisa is so busy looking back that she makes the worst auction mistake. Rene finds a bargain and makes the most of it. Ivy unfolds his way to a profit and unloads some stuff onto Lisa.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S14/E7 - King Of Orange Chicken'. Rene shows up in Orange and declares himself king, but Dusty won't concede the title. Meanwhile, Kenny accidentally reinvents the wheel and Lisa sees things from a different perspective.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S14/E9 - Reign Or Shine'. King Darrell is on a mission to defend his throne, but Rene and Casey have other ideas. Meanwhile, Kenny gets bowled over by his locker and Lisa manages to rope something decent.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S14/E10 - The King Of Montebowl-O'. Barry is ready to learn, and shows up at the auction with a present for a certain someone. Brandi and Bozek's spirits get a lift, and Ivy's son celebrates his birthday with a special locker.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S14/E12 - Zip Tie Lies'. Rene and Casey take a gamble in San Bernardino, and Kenny stumbles over some odd-looking car parts. Meanwhile, Lisa keeps disaster at bay with an unusually expensive locker.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S14/E13 - Children Of The Cornbread'. Ivy is on the warpath in Lancaster, trying to intimidate the other buyers. Brandi begrudgingly lets Bozek decide which locker they buy, and Dusty goes up against the King to prove a point.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S14/E15 - Two For The Price Of Dust'. The big guns come out in Riverside, but Rene isn't having any of it. Darrell presses his luck with a smaller locker and makes a neat profit.

programme.title: Secrets In The Ice
programme.desc: 'S4/E7 - Ice Age Battlefield'. Swiss fisherman uncovers ancient Celtic relics in Lake Neuchatel, hinting at a violent Iron Age battle around 225 BCE. In Mebrak caves, a burial chamber revealed mummified bodies from 400 BC to 50 AD.

programme.title: Secrets In The Ice
programme.desc: 'S4/E8 - Siberian Death Mask'. A Siberian death mask reveals cranial surgery, exposing advanced medical skills of the Tashtyk culture. Explore Magdalenian Stone Age rituals, where cannibalistic funeral practices were uncovered.

programme.title: Secrets In The Ice
programme.desc: 'S4/E9 - Frozen Secrets Of Prehistoric Warfare'. The 2021 floods in Uttarakhand, India spark fears of buried Cold War nuclear devices, but scientists traced the disaster to a glacier collapse.

programme.title: Secrets In The Ice
programme.desc: 'S4/E10 - The Donner Party's Lost Legacy'. In the Sierra Nevada mountains, the Donner Party's tragic tale is revisited with the recent uncovering of artifacts, including glass shards and a writing slate.

programme.title: Legends Of The Pharaohs
programme.desc: 'S2/E1 - Birth Of The Tutankhamun Dynasty'. Based on the most recent research, the series captures the energy and immediacy of a living world, and the drama and splendour of this fascinating ancient civilisation.

programme.title: Jesse James' Hidden Treasure
programme.desc: Jesse Woodson James, America's most notorious outlaw, robbed his way to over half-a-billion dollars. Officially, he died in 1882, but is there more to the story than it seems?

programme.title: Looting History
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Blood Antiquities: Islamic State And The Theft Of Syria's Past'. ISIS funded its regime by ripping loot out of the ground and selling it. But will collectors acknowledge that their cash was funding mayhem?

programme.title: Looting History
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - Behind The Mask: Robbing The Land Of The Pharaohs'. A tiny fragment of papyrus worth more than its weight in gold is the beginning of the end for superstar Oxford don Dirk Obbink.

programme.title: World War II With Tom Hanks
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Blitz'. After toppling the Netherlands and Belgium, Nazi Germany pushes further west. The Allies scramble to support France as Churchill is forced to defend Britain from the skies...

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S14/E14 - Proxy Moxie'. Barry utilises a little-known tactic to snatch up a locker, and it ties him up in knots. Brandi shops in the bargain basement and puts on quite a show in the process.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S14/E15 - Two For The Price Of Dust'. The big guns come out in Riverside, but Rene isn't having any of it. Darrell presses his luck with a smaller locker and makes a neat profit.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S14/E16 - It's A Safe Time To Get Lit!'. Lisa has her own take on a beach day as she heads to Huntington Beach. Darrell spends the right amount of time going through his locker.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S15/E1 - All Hail, King Brandi: The Rule-Her Of West Covina'. Brandi makes a serious land grab. Rene can't resist the mystery of a good safe. Kenny can't satisfy his hunger, and Barry poaches from the competition.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S15/E2 - Yolo Bolo!'. The doctor is in... in Riverside. Rene goes big. Ivy scores a packed locker and stumbles across an antique of unusual origin.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S15/E3 - Stanton In The Place Where You Work'. Rene has lukewarm results bobbin' for profits in Stanton. Dusty finds a hoard of quality equipment, inking himself a decent payday.

programme.title: History's Greatest Mysteries
programme.desc: 'S7/E5 - The Hunt For The Kraken'. It's one of the most legendary monsters lurking in the vast open seas. With stories going back hundreds of years, this elusive creature has terrorised sailors and baffled scientists.

programme.title: Junk & Disorderly: Henry's...
programme.desc: 'Junk & Disorderly: Henry's Wreck-Trospective. S1/E3 - The Bromley Wreck-Trospective'. Henry, Allen, Guy and Sam look back at some unforgettable adventures, starting with a deep dive into Francis's incredible shed packed to the rafters.

programme.title: Junk & Disorderly: Henry's...
programme.desc: 'Junk & Disorderly: Henry's Wreck-Trospective. S1/E4 - The Newbury Wreck-Trospective'. Henry, Allen, Guy and Sam revisit some standout moments, including a heart-pounding auction where Henry sets his sights on a Morris 8.

programme.title: American Pickers
programme.desc: 'S27/E8 - Two-Wheeled Treasures'. Mike nails a double deal at an epic Utah motorcycle museum. Robbie and Jersey scour a shuttered family museum that hasn't been touched in decades.

programme.title: Ultimate Mysteries
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - Paranormal Destinations'. In this episode, we visit hotspots known for weird and mysterious activity. Will new evidence uncover the truth behind Skinwalker Ranch?

programme.title: History's Greatest Picks With Mike...
programme.desc: 'History's Greatest Picks With Mike Wolfe. S1/E4 - Famous Finds'. From iconic robes, jerseys, crowns and sunglasses to dangerous weapons, we explore the wild tales of long-lost celebrity artefacts that turn into big-money paydays.
